idd-help.description: Manual-only, read-only help for questions about Intent-Driven Development methodology, concepts, workflows, skills, and expected Coding Agent behavior.

idd-route.description: Use a read-only routing step to classify an IDD-related request and select the smallest safe end-to-end workflow before handing off to the appropriate IDD skill.

idd-project-init.description: Initialize project-owned IDD intent state, then pause for a blocking bootstrap decision when an existing implementation has no current intent.

idd-verification-configure.description: Create or deliberately update project-specific `.idd/verification.yaml` rules without changing product intent.

idd-intent-bootstrap.description: Interactively discover, classify, confirm, and write initial current product intent using blocking user decisions for an existing implemented project without reliable IDD intent.

frontmatter.argument-hint: [whole repository or selected product roots and exclusions]

idd-glossary-build.description: Manual-only workflow to create or deliberately update the optional project glossary with only terminology whose incorrect interpretation could change the understanding of product intent.

interface.shortDescription: Create or update the project glossary

idd-intent-structure-audit.description: Diagnose semantic structure, ownership, organization, and normalization opportunities in current `.idd/intent/` without editing files.

idd-intent-estimate.description: Assess qualitative business complexity from current Product Intent without code inspection or file changes.

interface.shortDescription: Assess business complexity from Product Intent

frontmatter.argument-hint: [product area or IDD-NNNN IDs; default: available current intent]

idd-skip.description: Manual-only command. Perform the current request without applying Intent-Driven Development routing or updating durable intent.

interface.shortDescription: Perform a request without IDD routing

idd-intent-clarify.description: Resolve ambiguity, disproportionate complexity and missing user-facing behavior in a proposed Product requirement with focused read-only discovery; propose confirmed or unconfirmed clarified intent without file edits or automatic handoff.

idd-intent-brainstorm.description: Explore alternative Product directions and substantially different ideas, challenge assumptions using bounded read-only research, and propose optional user-confirmed handoffs without editing Product Intent or code.

idd-intent-change.description: Update current `.idd/intent/` product intent for add, modify, and remove operations; update existing owners or create a new owning spec, ADR, or spike when required.

idd-engineering-change.description: Manage explicit durable Engineering Rule add, modify, and remove mutations under `.idd/engineering/`, with batch semantic planning, lazy bootstrap, stable allocation, Factory safety guard, and direct shared mechanical validation.

idd-code-implement.description: Implement current product intent or perform a behavior-preserving implementation change, then verify the result against relevant `.idd/intent/` specifications.

idd-intent-drift-audit.description: Audit whether current implementation behavior conforms to durable Product Intent in `.idd/intent/` for an explicitly defined focused or project-wide scope.

frontmatter.argument-hint: [audit scope: feature, intent ID, implementation area, failure, or project-wide]

idd-intent-import.description: Migrate supplied durable knowledge into normalized Product Intent and explicit source-owned Engineering Rules, with safe semantic planning, lazy Engineering bootstrap, conflict blocking, and shared mechanical validation.

idd-intent-lint.description: Check mechanical `.idd/intent/` consistency (default) or safely repair unambiguous technical defects when explicitly authorized.

frontmatter.allowed-tools: Read Glob Grep Edit Write Bash

idd-intent-normalize-current.description: Perform focused structural normalization of existing `.idd/intent/` product intent without changing product meaning.

idd-code-update-intent.description: Update `.idd/intent/` product intent from confirmed implementation behavior.

idd-factory-configure.description: Configure and review project-owned Factory model policy in .idd/execution.yaml: initial setup, exact edits, read-only comparisons, and evidence-based model refresh, with authorization before selected changes are saved.

interface.shortDescription: Configure, review, and refresh Factory models

idd-factory-run.description: Prepare durable Intent/Engineering policy and orchestrate fresh generic child agents that fully load installed internal Factory Skills for bounded Planner and Worker assignments.

idd-intent-visual-brainstorm.description: Clarify user-confirmed Visual Intent from screenshots or mockups using professional design interpretation and optional locally supplied comparison-card images, without changing specs or code.

idd-internal-factory-planner.description: Internal Factory Planner protocol. Use only inside a fresh child context spawned by idd-factory-run with the full phase-appropriate bounded assignment; otherwise return BLOCKED.

idd-internal-factory-worker.description: Internal Factory Worker protocol. Use only inside a fresh child context spawned by idd-factory-run with exactly one complete Task and verified scope/provenance; otherwise return BLOCKED.

idd-intent-cosmic.description: Measure COSMIC v5.0 functional size from current Product Intent with evidence-backed E/X/R/W, in-skill semantic self-review, and explicit coverage gates; read-only and independent of business complexity.

interface.shortDescription: Measure COSMIC function points from Product Intent

frontmatter.argument-hint: [product area or IDD-NNNN IDs; default: current documented intent]
